title: Jamaican Rice and Peas
subtitle: Long-grain rice cooked in coconut milk with kidney beans
excerpt: Long-grain rice simmered in coconut milk with kidney beans, scotch bonnet and thyme. Rich, fragrant and the natural partner to almost every Jamaican main.
sourceNotes: The classic Sunday rice of Jamaica, traditionally made with kidney beans (called 'peas') and coconut milk.

recipe.freezeNotes: Cool completely, freeze in airtight containers for up to 3 months. Reheat with a splash of water.
recipe.batchNotes: Scales well. Use a larger pot and keep the ratio of rice to liquid the same.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Cook a day ahead and reheat gently with a splash of water to loosen.

content.text: Rice and peas is Jamaica's Sunday staple. It is long-grain rice cooked in coconut milk with kidney beans and scotch bonnet. It gives a deeply fragrant, slightly creamy side. Leave the scotch bonnet whole so the heat is gentle rather than sharp.

items.prepNote: rinsed until the water runs clear

content.text: Put the coconut milk, water, kidney beans, spring onions, scotch bonnet, thyme, garlic, allspice and salt into the large saucepan.
Bring to the boil over a medium-high heat. Stir once to combine.
Add the rinsed rice and stir. Bring back to the boil.
Reduce the heat to the lowest setting. Cover with a tight lid.
Cook undisturbed for 20 minutes. Do not lift the lid.
Remove from the heat. Rest for 5 minutes with the lid still on.
Lift the lid and remove the scotch bonnet, spring onions and thyme sprigs. Stir in the butter if using. Fluff with a fork and serve.

items.symptom: The rice is undercooked after 20 minutes.
items.cause: The lid was not tight or the heat was too low.
items.fix: Add 50ml of hot water, re-cover and cook for a further 5 minutes on a slightly higher heat.

items.symptom: The scotch bonnet burst and the rice is very hot.
items.cause: The chilli was pierced or knocked too hard while stirring.
items.fix: Handle the whole scotch bonnet gently. Remove it as soon as the rice is cooked.

items.symptom: The rice is sticky and clumped.
items.cause: The rice was not rinsed before cooking.
items.fix: Always rinse rice under cold water until the water runs clear to remove surface starch.
